It's a 2-star serviced apartment in Bang Muang, Bang Yai, near Central Westgate, with one-bedroom units of 26 sqm and a balcony. body.html: The main selling point of The Grand Residence Bang Yai is an apartment-style room in the Bang Yai area at a light price. The building sits in Bang Muang, Bang Yai District, near Central Westgate, and the units are one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartments of 26 sqm with a small balcony. It suits people working or running errands in the area for several days who want more space than a standard hotel room, with a clothes-drying spot and a separate seating area.

What sets it apart from hotels at a similar price is its self-sufficient set of facilities. The units have air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a coffee/tea maker and, importantly, a washing machine — which makes longer stays much easier, with no need to haul laundry to a shop. The building has a lift, free parking, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour security, which adds peace of mind for solo travellers.

"The room was bigger than expected, and having a washing machine in the unit was so convenient over several days. There's a convenience store and a Lotus's within walking distance, and free parking meant no worries. Good value for the price."

On location, set expectations first: this place sits in a side soi in Bang Yai, not on a main road and not within walking distance of the train. The Purple Line Talad Bang Yai station is about 5 km away, so you'll need a motorbike taxi or a regular taxi to connect. The upside is that the surroundings are quiet and well stocked — there's a 7-Eleven, Lotus's, Big C Mini and FamilyMart nearby, and Central Westgate is a short drive away. Having your own car is the most convenient option, since parking is free.

To be honest, this is a 2-star apartment, not a full-service hotel. There's no grand lobby, no breakfast, no pool or gym, and staff may not be on site around the clock the way a hotel's are. Check-in at certain times may need to be arranged in advance, so it's worth confirming your arrival time with the property before you travel, to avoid waiting around on the day.

What to expect at this price is room condition and newness in line with the cost. These are rental apartments let out by the night, so the furniture and fittings lean practical rather than styled. Before booking, check what unit types are available for your dates, look at the latest room photos, and read recent reviews — quality at a place like this can vary from unit to unit and depending on who manages it.

Overall, The Grand Residence Bang Yai suits anyone who wants an apartment-style room in Bang Yai for a multi-day stay, with a washing machine and usable living space, on a budget. Rates start at about ฿600/night and rise with the season and length of stay, and the real-review score sits around 8.0, which is solid for this level. If you're fine with needing a car or a short motorbike-taxi hop to the station and you don't expect hotel service, it's good value in Bang Yai. But if you want full hotel service, breakfast, or to walk to the mall, compare it with Westgate Residence in the same zone.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Grand Residence Bang Yai, Nonthaburi

faq.q: Where is The Grand Residence Bang Yai and how do you get there?
faq.a: The property is in Bang Muang, Bang Yai District, Nonthaburi, in the Bang Yai area near Central Westgate. It sits in a side soi, not on a main road. The Purple Line Talad Bang Yai station is about 5 km away, so you'll need a motorbike taxi or a regular taxi to connect — it's not within walking distance. Having your own car is the most convenient option, since parking is free.

faq.q: What does The Grand Residence Bang Yai cost and what are the rooms like?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿600/night for a one-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment of 26 sqm with a balcony. Booking several nights usually brings the per-night rate down, which suits longer stays. Prices move with the season and length of stay, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Grand Residence Bang Yai have a washing machine and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there's an in-unit washing machine and free parking. It also has free Wi-Fi, a lift, 24-hour security, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and a coffee/tea maker. But there's no pool, gym or breakfast, since it's a budget apartment rather than a full-service hotel.

faq.q: How does check-in work at The Grand Residence Bang Yai?
faq.a: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is before 12:00 PM. As it's an apartment, staff may not be on site around the clock, so it's best to let the property know your arrival time in advance so you can pick up the key and get into your unit smoothly.

faq.q: Who is The Grand Residence Bang Yai best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for people working or running errands in Bang Yai for several days who want an apartment-style room with a washing machine and usable living space, on a budget. It suits travellers with their own car, since parking is free, and anyone who isn't fussed about breakfast or a pool.

faq.q: Is it convenient to get into the city from The Grand Residence Bang Yai?
faq.a: It's workable but you'll want a car or a motorbike-taxi hop. The property is in a soi and not within walking distance of the train; the Purple Line Talad Bang Yai station is about 5 km away. With your own car you can reach Central Westgate or the main road easily and Don Muang Airport in about 35 minutes. Without a car, take a motorbike taxi to connect with the Purple Line at Talad Bang Yai.
